In this video, I travel from mainland Africa to the beautiful island nation of Mauritius, and what I discover here is truly surprising! Imagine visiting a country thousands of kilometres away from India, located in the Indian Ocean near Africa, where you can experience a strong connection to Indian culture, Hindu traditions, Indian food, familiar languages, and people who make you feel as if you are somewhere in India. Yes, welcome to Mauritius – a country that feels like another India outside India!
